$comment: Copy to config/collector.json. Discovery scope and capture scope are separate: the recorder OBSERVES broadly but RECORDS only what is listed in selectors.

discoveryScope.$comment: Observed for metadata only, never subscribed. Keeps visibility into what could be captured. On the live exchange these prefixes match 104 Climate and Weather series; without the category filter they also match KXHIGHINFLATION, KXLOWESTRATE and KXHIGHMOVDJT.

selectors.$comment: The capture universe. Explicit by default -- expanding it should be a deliberate config change, not a side effect of a prefix matching more than intended.

sampling.$comment: 60s only, and deliberately NOT a research source of truth. These grids exist for dashboards, health checks, quick SQL and sanity checks. Research horizons are materialized offline from the delta stream via `npm run materialize`, which drives the SAME sampler code, so an offline 1s sample equals what live 1s sampling would have produced. A permanent 1s or 5s grid commits to one worldview and costs ~41 GB per three weeks for data that is fully recomputable.
